cells.normalized_text: Killing Weakened Enemies creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy and a Void Breach. Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon creating an Orb of Power.

sources.finding: Weakened kills spawn a Void Breach and a 2.5% Super Orb; ten seconds between activations.

sources.short_excerpt: No longer requires a precision kill to activate.
sources.finding: 7.1.0 removed precision kill qualification from Echo of Harvest.
Negative Void Fragment stats removed except stated exceptions; current Harvest row has no penalty.

implemented: Confirmed holder kill with historical Weaken creates a private 2.5% Orb and requests shared Void Breach; no precision or element requirement.
Historical position and Weaken evidence survive death cleanup and actual corpse removal; foreign Weaken grantor does not receive collector rewards.
Orb template emits explicit spawned/rejected/unobserved events retaining transient invocation context. Harvest starts ten-second cooldown only on successful Orb creation.
Holder-shared pending reservation and bounded death receipts suppress duplicate sources and queued repeat attempts; accepted invocation survives source detach.
Actual paid Shield Throw and native deaths produce physical pickups, current Starvation heals/extends Devour and grants base current-account energy; enhanced Feed composition tested.
Known missing recipient rejects both physical spawns without cooldown; injected unknown receipt after actual Orb write stops before Breach and cannot replay.
gaps: 完整Fragment/子职业装配、全部削弱来源与派生击杀信用、其他Orb/Breach生产者及多人Orb副本政策尚未完成；当前只实现本持有者私有副本。
原表明确Orb成功生成后十秒冷却。已知Orb失败仍独立尝试Breach、Breach自身五秒共享冷却、排队期间只接纳一次尝试以及卸下来源不取消已接纳调用，均为明确Chorus故障/调度政策，原作同帧失败与换装边界仍待校准。
回执death_ids按receipt_seconds有界保留，记录冷却或pending期间被抑制的击杀；十二秒测试输入不是原作冷却。不能据此承诺永久幂等、宿主无限迟到事实或物理世界故障恢复。
Orb寿命与收集半径必须提供，二十秒/半米为合成输入；Orb 2.5%与Harvest十秒取原表，但完整Super属性/活动/active Super收益仍未装配。
Breach 11.25%输入、外部归一化与当前Class账户复用上一阶段；测试归一化0.444444及CES .5/.75不当作完整原作校准。
Shield Throw加Feed the Void只验证引擎组合，不宣称合法Titan/Warlock跨职业配装。正式内容目录、HUD/动画/美术、多人可见性与实体跨维度/重启仍未完成。
